description: Deterministic, transparent, versioned mapping from an exact resolved formation string to a coarse formation FAMILY and structural descriptors. This mapping is a CONDITIONING KEY only. It carries NO behavioral assumption: a family label never implies width, directness, or tempo. Behavior is measured separately from the historical evidence (see FORMATION_BEHAVIOR_ANALYSIS.md). Any change to this table MUST bump the version (formation_family_v2, ...).
authority: Values are derived purely from the digit structure of the formation string (defenders / midfield bands / forwards). No club, league, or manager knowledge is used.

family_defs.BACK4_1STRIKER: 4 nominal defenders, single most-advanced striker line
family_defs.UNKNOWN_FORMATION: formation string absent, null, or not parseable

derivation_rule.note: For any exact formation not listed above, the family is derived deterministically from the leading digit (defender count) and trailing digit (forward count). This guarantees the mapping is total over all syntactically valid N-N-...-N strings.
steps: parse formation into integer bands split on '-'
defenders = first band; forwards = last band
if defenders == 3 and second band >= 4 -> BACK3_WINGBACK
